notes: This verse is Aramaic; the separately segmented determined-state endings are each aligned to a written ASV article under rule 15's Aramaic clause, and none of the four is left unrepresented because the ASV writes a 'the' for each.

The margin's 'under these heavens' would attach אֵלֶּה to שְׁמַיָּא; the ASV's text places it as the resumptive subject of 'shall perish', and the alignment follows the text with a discontinuous unit (rule 25).
